summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing a September 23, 2026 Nasdaq deficiency letter stating its Market Value of Listed Securities fell below the $35 million minimum under Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) for 30 consecutive business days. The company has until March 22, 2027 (180-day compliance period) to regain compliance, requiring MVLS of at least $35 million for ten consecutive business days. Trading continues uninterrupted under ticker HUBC; no advisor or board recommendation named. Failure triggers delisting notice with appeal rights. Watch for equity issuance, reverse split, or appeal risk.
